en.name: Overhead reaches
en.subtitle: Follow along · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand facing the camera, feet apart and hands by your sides.
Slowly reach both hands up above your head, as far as is comfortable. Keep your feet on the floor.
Bring both hands back to your sides. That is one movement.
en.focus: Reach comfortably; leave space above your head in the camera view.

zh-Hant.name: 雙手向上伸展
zh-Hant.subtitle: 跟著做 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭站立，雙腳分開，雙手放在身旁。
慢慢把雙手向頭頂上方伸展，伸到舒適的位置，雙腳留在地上。
把雙手放回身旁，完成一次動作。
zh-Hant.focus: 舒適地伸展，鏡頭畫面要留出頭頂上方的空間。
